text:
Aisha: quick flag — EU S3 was flaky last night, kafka commits lagged. We have ~40h of late telemetry and hourly aggregates are stale. thinking a staged rehydrate instead of full shard blast. thoughts?
Ben: +1 staged. last full run blew cpu cost. prefer hot-window then sampled sweep.
Leah: agree. Console must show a dry-run cost estimate before kick. Ops kept starting replays blind.
Raj: add origin tagging in replay metadata (origin=s3-eu-3155) so we can skip already-committed offsets later. runner currently doesn't include origin.
sre-bot: incident resolved: ingest-eu-s3-3155540000, 1h ago.
Aisha: rough policy: hot=last 10h full coverage (atomic commit), warm=10-72h sampled 8-12% by tenant (partial commits ok), cold>72h skip. canary hot on 1% tenants first.
Ben: deterministic sampling is key. sample_selector: hash(tenant_id||hour||seed) % 100 < sample_pct. include seed in job yaml.
Leah: Console dry-run should return est_cpu_hours, est_rows_touched, est_s3_gb, est_cost_usd, est_duration. add "auto-abort if cost > $X" checkbox.
Raj: also add per-tenant cap for warm window: max_slots_per_tenant=2 and global_warm_concurrency=45. big tenants should not hog slots.
Aisha: dedupe-pass idea: pre-run a cheap selector to filter keys where aggregate_ts >= event_ingest_time. massively reduces work.
Ben: +1. also require replay to use event_ingest_time for watermarking — arrival_time will bounce and cause oscillation.
Leah: devex: provide a one-click Console template "EU staged rehydrate" prefilled and with warnings. show progress per-hour and per-tenant slot usage.
sre-bot: runbook note: if replay queue > 450 tasks, throttle low-priority queue to 0 and page on-call.
Raj: implement backfill-id header x-replay-backfill-id for traceability; push to traces and billing logs.
Aisha: commit strategy: hot atomic using staging-table swap; warm writes partial aggregates so ops see incremental improvement and can abort.
Ben: add regression_check flag for canary; run golden queries and compare delta, auto-stop if regression > 0.5%.
Leah: also include a dry-run option that simulates dedupe savings so Console can show a optimistic and pessimistic cost estimate.
Raj: small ops edge: include sample_seed + sample_version in job metadata so picking logic is reproducible across retries.
Aisha: draft YAML for ops trial below:
```
policy: staged_rehydrate_v2
hot_window: 10h
warm_window: 72h
hot_coverage: 100
warm_sample_pct: 10
sample_seed: 2026-03-21
global_warm_concurrency: 45
max_slots_per_tenant: 2
hot_commit: atomic_staging_swap
warm_commit: partial
allow_partial_commit_warm: true
trace_header: x-replay-backfill-id
auto_abort_cost_usd: 600
regression_check: {enabled: true, threshold_pct: 0.5}
```
Ben: LGTM. tag me on PR for dry-run cost calc.
Leah: I'll draft Console copy and the one-click template. include a warning banner for EU late-ingest incidents.
Raj: I'll add origin tagging + staging-swap code in runner. ETA EOD.
Aisha: plan: wire dry-run UI + canary, validate regressions, then hot full run, then warm sampled sweep. ping #eng-sre on blockers.
console-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /api/replay/dryrun -> payload: {"policy_yaml":"<yaml>"} returns {"estimate_cpu_hours":"X","estimate_s3_gb":"Y","rows_touched":"Z","est_cost_usd":"$N"}.
Aisha: thanks all. I'll post PR with config and console template once wired.
Ben: will review the PR.
Leah: will add UX unit tests for banners and progress bars.
Aisha: closing loop: canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC unless someone objects. if S3 flares again, escalate.
